title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Udhayam NH4
desc: Prabhu, a young college student, kidnaps his lover Rithika when her father disapproves of their relationship. Manoj Menon, an encounter specialist, is appointed to track them down.

title: Meesaya Murukku
desc: Adhi, an aspiring musician, falls in love with Nila, a young woman in his college. Soon, he finds himself surrounded by several challenges as he tries to pursue his dreams.

title: Thulladha Manamum Thullum
desc: Kutty is a good-hearted soul, but unfortunate incidents tend to portray his ruffian side whenever he encounters the girl he loves. A bizarre incident brings them closer and yet keeps them apart.

title: Ayogya
desc: Karnan is a corrupt police inspector who frequently bends the rules to suit his own needs. However, he realigns his morals and tries to do the right thing after a life-changing event.

title: Dagaalty
desc: An ingenious conman embarks on a mission to find a girl and transport her back to Mumbai. However, the fraudster's life takes an unexpected turn after he falls in love with his target.
